rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records across the import does not exceed 0.1% (accounts for school closures/mergers across biennial CRDC releases).
Verifies that each input contains non-empty data meeting its expected freshness threshold (up to 2024 for the latest biennial CRDC release).

params.query: SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(MinDate) <= '2014' AND MAX(MinDate) <= '2014' THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2014' WHEN MIN(MinDate) = '2016' THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2016' WHEN MAX(MinDate) >= '2018' THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2024' ELSE FALSE END AS is_fresh, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM stats
